fields.title: Google Maps business status record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Google's listing data plus a Google Business Profile health assessment. One BUSINESS row per listing, one AREA_SUMMARY row per run, ERROR rows on failure. Google adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query or identifier that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-tbm-map-search, S2-preview-place, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: search_failed, unresolvable_input, detail_failed or no_place_data.

_searchQuery.title: Search query
_searchQuery.description: The query this business came from; null for directly supplied places.

name.title: Business name
name.description: Business name as shown on Google Maps.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Phone number on the listing, when present.

website.title: Website
website.description: Website on the listing. Null is itself the sales signal.

openingHours.title: Opening hours
openingHours.description: Weekly schedule where Google supplied it.

openNow.title: Open now
openNow.description: Google's status line at scrape time.

googleMapsUrl.title: Google Maps URL
googleMapsUrl.description: Canonical Maps link for the business.

claimStatus.title: Claim status
claimStatus.description: 'unclaimed' or 'claimed'. Unclaimed means Google still offers an 'Own this business?' action, i.e. no owner has taken the profile.

isUnclaimed.title: Is unclaimed
isUnclaimed.description: Boolean form of claimStatus - the primary prospecting filter.

businessStatus.title: Business status
businessStatus.description: operational, temporarily_closed or permanently_closed. Closure wording only appears on detail records, and Google excludes closed businesses from search.

isOperational.title: Is operational
isOperational.description: True when the listing is not marked closed.

hasPhone.title: Has phone
hasPhone.description: Whether a phone number is listed.

hasOpeningHours.title: Has opening hours
hasOpeningHours.description: Whether any opening hours are listed.

reviewsCount.title: Reviews count
reviewsCount.description: Total Google reviews - a thin count signals a neglected profile.

opportunityScore.title: Opportunity score
opportunityScore.description: 0-100. Unclaimed 40, no website 25, no phone 10, no hours 10, few reviews 10, low rating 5. Forced to 0 for permanently closed listings, which are never prospects.

opportunityIssues.title: Opportunity issues
opportunityIssues.description: The specific problems found, e.g. unclaimed, no_website, no_phone, few_reviews.

issueCount.title: Issue count
issueCount.description: How many issues this listing has.

verifiedWithPlaceDetails.title: Verified with place details
verifiedWithPlaceDetails.description: Whether this assessment used the richer detail record rather than the search entry alone.

area.title: Area
area.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: the geographic filter the sweep covered.

queries.title: Queries
queries.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: the business types swept.

businessesAssessed.title: Businesses assessed
businessesAssessed.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: how many listings the summary covers.

unclaimed.title: Unclaimed count
unclaimed.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: unclaimed listings in the area.

unclaimedPercent.title: Unclaimed %
unclaimedPercent.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: share of listings that are unclaimed - the market-opportunity headline.

withoutWebsite.title: Without website count
withoutWebsite.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings with no website.

withoutWebsitePercent.title: Without website %
withoutWebsitePercent.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: share with no website.

withoutPhone.title: Without phone count
withoutPhone.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings with no phone number.

unclaimedAndNoWebsite.title: Unclaimed and no website
unclaimedAndNoWebsite.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings failing both - the strongest prospects.

permanentlyClosed.title: Permanently closed count
permanentlyClosed.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings marked permanently closed.

temporarilyClosed.title: Temporarily closed count
temporarilyClosed.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings marked temporarily closed.

averageOpportunityScore.title: Average opportunity score
averageOpportunityScore.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: mean score across the area.

highOpportunityCount.title: High-opportunity count
highOpportunityCount.description: AREA_SUMMARY rows: listings scoring 65 or more.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for scanning an audit.

prospects.title: Sales prospects
prospects.description: Highest-opportunity listings with the contact details you have.

status.title: Status & verification
status.description: Claim and closure status, and how it was established.
